meta.source: Manual_Didactica_Universitaria.docx (Word styles, direct run/paragraph formatting, header/footer, numbering). Point sizes converted at 96 dpi (1pt = 1.3333px, 20 twips = 1pt).

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Brand navy. Unit headings (H1), cover title, «Concepto clave» labels, glossary terms, ribbon rules. Text on `paper` and `concept-surface`.

tokens.name: azure
tokens.usage: Brand azure. Section and subsection headings (H2, H3) and the cover kicker. Text on `paper`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy, list items, table cells (Word «auto» colour). Text on `paper`, `band` and `concept-surface`.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground.

tokens.name: concept-surface
tokens.usage: Fill of the «Concepto clave» box.

tokens.name: concept-border
tokens.usage: 0.75pt frame of the «Concepto clave» box. Decorative (the fill carries the box); light theme is 2.1:1 on `paper`, kept from the source.

tokens.name: table-head
tokens.usage: Header row fill of data tables. Pair with `on-table-head`.

tokens.name: on-table-head
tokens.usage: Header-cell text on `table-head`.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Zebra fill on even body rows of data tables (rows 2, 4, …).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: 0.5pt hairline: data-table grid and the running-header underline. Decorative; 1.75:1 on `paper` in both themes, kept from the source.

tokens.name: caption
tokens.usage: Table captions and cover metadata lines. Text on `paper`.

tokens.name: subtitle
tokens.usage: Cover subtitle (italic). Text on `paper`.

tokens.name: lede
tokens.usage: Cover description line under the subtitle. Text on `paper`.

tokens.name: running
tokens.usage: Running header and page-number footer. 3.2:1 on `paper` in the source at 8pt: below 4.5:1, kept exact; do not reuse for reading text.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Hyperlinks and DOIs (Word «Hyperlink» style, underlined). Text on `paper`.

tokens.name: word-heading
tokens.usage: Word style default for Heading 1/2/4/5. The manual overrides it with `navy`/`azure`; use only for documents that keep the plain Word styles.

tokens.name: word-heading-deep
tokens.usage: Word style default for Heading 3/6. Overridden in the manual by `azure`.

families.serif: Cambria, Caladea, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif

tokens.name: space-3pt
tokens.usage: Data-table cell padding, top and bottom (60 twips); caption space before.

tokens.name: space-5pt
tokens.usage: Data-table cell padding, left and right (100 twips); list item and H3 space after.

tokens.name: space-6pt
tokens.usage: H2 space after; «Concepto clave» box padding top/bottom (120 twips); glossary and reference space after.

tokens.name: space-8pt
tokens.usage: H1 space after; caption space after; box padding left/right (160 twips).

tokens.name: space-9pt
tokens.usage: Body paragraph space after; H3 space before.

tokens.name: space-12pt
tokens.usage: H2 space before.

tokens.name: space-16pt
tokens.usage: H1 space before.

tokens.name: indent-bullet
tokens.usage: Bullet hanging indent (360 twips); each list level adds 48px.

tokens.name: indent-hang
tokens.usage: Reference hanging indent and first list level (720 twips = 0.5in).

tokens.name: page-margin
tokens.usage: Page margins, all sides (1in).

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Text block width (6.5in on US Letter); tables span it in full.

radius.note: The manual is square: boxes, tables and rules have no rounding.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every box, table and rule.

stroke.note: Word border sizes in eighths of a point, converted to px.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Data-table grid and running-header underline (sz 4 = 0.5pt), in `rule`.

tokens.name: stroke-box
tokens.usage: «Concepto clave» frame (sz 6 = 0.75pt), in `concept-border`.

tokens.name: stroke-ribbon
tokens.usage: Top and bottom rules of the cover ribbon (sz 8 = 1pt), in `navy`.
